attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 31 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry enumerates two people, husband and wife, each with a heading, so it is two folders. The corpus holds no Stratonice at all, and the namesweep returned nothing for the name. The page gives no year, no city and no persecutor, so no `dates` object and no location. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
